submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 at 35 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest possible signal efficiency (92.3%) at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate while satisfying all project constraints.

PERFORMANCE JUSTIFICATION:
A comprehensive efficiency scan was performed across all three candidate algorithms at multiple thresholds (20, 30, 40, 50, 60 GeV), followed by fine-tuning around the optimal region. The results clearly demonstrate Algorithm-L3's superior performance:
- Algorithm-L3 @ 35 GeV: 92.3% efficiency (RECOMMENDED)
- Algorithm-L2 @ 40 GeV: 85.1% efficiency (7.2 pp lower)
- Algorithm-L1 @ 40 GeV: 73.3% efficiency (19.0 pp lower)

Algorithm-L3 provides substantial efficiency improvements of 7.2 percentage points over L2 and 19.0 percentage points over L1, directly fulfilling the project goal of maximizing signal efficiency.

OPTIMIZATION PROCESS:
The 35 GeV threshold was identified through systematic optimization: initial coarse scans (20-60 GeV range) identified the peak region near 30 GeV, followed by fine-tuning scans (25-37 GeV) that revealed the true optimum at 35 GeV, yielding a 0.6 pp improvement over the coarse-scan result.

VALIDATION:
The recommended configuration (92.3% @ 35 GeV) matches excellently with the independent 2025 baseline simulation (92% @ 35 GeV), providing strong cross-validation of the analysis.

All hard constraints are satisfied, making Algorithm-L3 at 35 GeV the optimal choice for the Level-1 trigger implementation.
